p4-radix-items-rows.description: P4 class R: the recorded RadixRun payload layout items rows is printed as the explicit default layout argument RadixRun<_, _, ::std::vec::Vec<_>> (identical Rust type to RadixRun<_, _>)

p4-packed-canon.description: P4 class P: authored canon(packed) advice records dedup::Packed for canonical rows records (EXT-PackedCanon, PL-PackedCanon); same answers and order, different build work, measured by paired timing

c7-relational-projection.description: Contract 7 issues 9/10: authored plain-variable heads carry recorded ownership; recursion realizes borrowed head columns uniformly with Clone before CQ planning/canonicalization, without recognizing Rust copies or inspecting types.

rules.reason: Seed x ownership realization changes only *x to the uniform ::core::clone::Clone::clone(x); the generated i32 binding and its placement are unchanged. Rustc resolves the same scalar copy without compiler type inspection.
Seed y ownership realization changes only *y to the uniform ::core::clone::Clone::clone(y); the generated i32 binding and its placement are unchanged.
Step x ownership realization changes only *x to the uniform ::core::clone::Clone::clone(x); all scans, joins, maps, Sort and fixpoint operations remain at the same positions.
Step z ownership realization changes only *z to the uniform ::core::clone::Clone::clone(z); the generated i32 binding and its placement are unchanged.
